newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish bond yields end down on CPI, crown firms.
newsitem.headline: Swedish bond yields end down on CPI, crown firms.

text.p: Swedish bond yields ended lower on Thursday and the crown strengthened somewhat after a lower-than-expected consumer price index for January.
Data showed prices rose by 0.1 percent in January and for a year-on-year fall of 0.1 percent while expectations were for a monthly rise of 0.4 percent.
The data created hopes about a repo rate cut, although some analysts thought the crown was too soft and volatile.
"The chances of a cut have increased but before that could happen the crown has to firm," an analyst said. The Riksbank left rates unchanged at a Thursday board meeting.
